snippet.title: Ned's Garden - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Ned's Garden
1985 - Magnetic Magazines Ltd (UK),16/48 Magazine Tape 23
ZX-Spectrum 48K - Arcade Game: Maze

Recorded by Jim Waterman (with rollback)

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/3381/ZX-Spectrum/Neds_Garden

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
